Question: Assalamualaykum - Thanks a lot for your kind services & your patience towards answering 1000?s of queries of this Umma, which help us to learn & to follow the right path of Islam. My Question ? 1) One of my sister saw in her dream that my deceased mother stating - "Please provide me one bulb there is too much dark here, by listening this my sister told that I will get the bulb and walk towards a street pole to take a bulb from that and then her 6 years old son ran by saying that he will get it and got accident from the coming truck and found alive luckily after accident." 2) In her other dream she saw - ?I have given some money to my sister and my mother asked & took Rs.250/- from her hand and went away? 3) 2 years back she saw "Please remove this spider net and clean it, there is too much dust here? 4) She also saw in her dream - ?my mother standing very sadly in our house? Mufti sab kindly give the tabeer/guidance of these dreams. Jazakumullah! Answer ID: 20369 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 539/425/H=1431) Masha-Allah, all are good dreams. The meaning of these dreams is that you, your sister and other relatives try to send the reward to your late mother by reciting the holy Quran, durood and offering nafl salah, and giving charity and fulfilling the need of poor and needy persons. Insha-Allah, by this the deceased people would get benefit as well as those who practice it they too would get infinite reward in this world and the hereafter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
